title.en: Protect a score snapshot from outside changes
title.zh: 保护成绩快照，隔离外部修改

goal.en: Follow ownership across constructors and getters.
goal.zh: 沿构造器和 getter 跟踪数据所有权。

title.en: Use a value object as a map key
title.zh: 用值对象作为 Map 的键

goal.en: Separate identity, value equality and hash collisions.
goal.zh: 区分引用身份、值相等与哈希冲突。

title.en: Build a small editor with undo
title.zh: 做一个可以撤销的小编辑器

goal.en: Turn an object model into a testable feature.
goal.zh: 把对象模型变成可测试的小功能。

title.en: Grow an owned array without losing it
title.zh: 安全扩容自己拥有的数组

goal.en: Connect ownership, overflow checks and amortized cost.
goal.zh: 把所有权、溢出检查和摊还成本连起来。

title.en: Read a complete frame from a byte stream
title.zh: 从字节流中读出完整消息

goal.en: Separate short reads, clean EOF and truncated payloads.
goal.zh: 区分短读、正常 EOF 和正文截断。

title.en: Define a file format instead of dumping a struct
title.zh: 定义文件格式，而不是直接写出结构体

goal.en: Design, encode, validate and test a tiny binary format.
goal.zh: 设计、编码、校验并测试小型二进制格式。

title.en: When greedy fails: pack whole science kits
title.zh: 贪心失效时：装入不可拆分的科学套件

goal.en: Derive a state, prove the recurrence and recover a solution.
goal.zh: 定义状态、证明递推，再恢复具体解。

title.en: Handle a negative edge with Bellman–Ford
title.zh: 用 Bellman–Ford 处理负权边

goal.en: Replace the settled-node assumption with a pass invariant.
goal.zh: 用逐轮不变量替代永久确定节点的假设。

title.en: Start BFS from every exit at once
title.zh: 让 BFS 同时从所有出口出发

goal.en: Solve many nearest-source queries in one traversal.
goal.zh: 用一次遍历解决多个最近源点查询。

title.en: Find a shortest word that separates two DFAs
title.zh: 找到区分两个 DFA 的最短单词

goal.en: Turn equivalence into reachability and recover a counterexample.
goal.zh: 把等价性转成可达性，并恢复具体反例。

title.en: Count parse trees instead of assuming one
title.zh: 数清语法树，不要默认只有一种解析

goal.en: Explain ambiguity with a recurrence and visible trees.
goal.zh: 通过递推式和可见语法树解释歧义。

title.en: Search for witnesses and counterexamples in a finite model
title.zh: 在有限模型中寻找见证与反例

goal.en: Make quantifier order concrete with witnesses.
goal.zh: 用见证把量词顺序变成具体问题。

title.en: Reopen a state when A* finds a better route
title.zh: A* 找到更优路径时重新展开状态

goal.en: Distinguish admissibility, consistency and reopening.
goal.zh: 区分可采纳性、一致性和重新展开。

title.en: Keep long-text likelihoods in log space
title.zh: 在对数空间中计算长文本似然

goal.en: Connect smoothing, repeated words and stable normalization.
goal.zh: 连接平滑、词频与稳定归一化。

title.en: See which class disappears inside an average
title.zh: 看清平均数掩盖了哪个类别

goal.en: Calculate class reports before comparing averages.
goal.zh: 先计算逐类报告，再比较平均指标。

title.en: Expose leakage with a deliberately simple memorizer
title.zh: 用刻意简单的记忆器暴露泄漏

goal.en: Make the evaluation boundary match deployment.
goal.zh: 让评估边界匹配部署问题。

title.en: Choose a decision threshold with an explicit error cost
title.zh: 用明确错误代价选择决策阈值

goal.en: Calculate mistakes, costs and the probability decision rule.
goal.zh: 计算错误、代价与概率决策规则。

title.en: Compute a finite loss even when a probability underflows
title.zh: 概率下溢时仍能计算有限损失

goal.en: Connect log-sum-exp, cross-entropy and gradient checks.
goal.zh: 连接 log-sum-exp、交叉熵和梯度核对。

title.en: Accumulate gradients when microbatches have different sizes
title.zh: 微批次大小不同时正确累积梯度

goal.en: Trace sample weights through the loss and optimizer step.
goal.zh: 沿损失计算和更新过程跟踪样本权重。

title.en: Return a detection box to the original image
title.zh: 把检测框还原到原始图像

goal.en: Carry coordinate metadata through the entire image pipeline.
goal.zh: 在整个图像流程中传递坐标变换信息。

title.en: Compute segmentation IoU without counting ignored pixels
title.zh: 排除忽略像素，计算分割 IoU

goal.en: Derive IoU from counts and state the averaging convention.
goal.zh: 从计数推导 IoU，并说明平均规则。

title.en: Align events with timestamps, offsets and a tolerance
title.zh: 用时间戳、偏移和容差对齐事件

goal.en: Check clocks and missing matches before combining modalities.
goal.zh: 融合模态前先检查时钟与缺失匹配。

title.en: Evaluate retrieval with several relevant results per query
title.zh: 评估每条查询有多个正确结果的检索任务

goal.en: Separate ranking quality, multiple positives and annotation coverage.
goal.zh: 区分排序质量、多正例与标注覆盖。
